register.text: A five-year bond of the Republic of San Marino on the international market, at a coupon of 3.625% against 6.50% on the 2023 issue it refinances. It funds the State budget as a whole; its proceeds are not earmarked to any one of the seven standards.
by: Secretariat of State for Finance and Budget

register.name: Domestic government bonds of 2025 (2.00% 2026, 2.15% 2030 and 2.45% 2035)
register.detail: Secretariat of State for Finance and Budget · €50M at 2.00%, issued 23 October 2025, due 23 December 2026 (Delegated Decree no. 125/2025) · €27.5M at 2.15% due 1 July 2030 and €27.5M at 2.45% due 1 July 2035, issued 1 July 2025 (Delegated Decrees nos. 81 and 82/2025)
register.note: The amount adds the three issues of €50,000,000, €27,500,000 and €27,500,000 (arithmetic); the table states no total
register.text: Three bonds of the Republic of San Marino sold on the domestic market in 2025, of fourteen months, five years and ten years, each still to be redeemed in full on 1 June 2026. They fund the State budget as a whole; their proceeds are not earmarked to any one of the seven standards.
by: Secretariat of State for Finance and Budget
